purpose: Estimate finite lower-noise BB-144 all-shot decoder failure rates for four matched controlled CSS arms and report syndrome validity crossed with logical projection for every final decoder proposal.

sampling.shot_ids: prefix 0..N-1 at each rate, identical across all four arms

reporting_axes.missing_proposal: no_proposal counted as primary failure but reported separately
reporting_axes.invalid_logical_note: logical projection against pinned LZ is computed for diagnostics even when residual syndrome is nonzero; it is not a code-space logical coset

precision.interval_method: two-sided Clopper-Pearson, Bonferroni alpha spending across six prespecified looks and two precision metrics for each arm/rate; separate simultaneous cell intervals across five categories
precision.primary_failure: any shot without a selected syndrome-valid and logically correct recovery; four diagnostic proposal cells and no-selection count remain separate
precision.stop_when: all four arms at one rate meet the failure-count and relative-width criteria for both all-shot decoder failure and selected valid-syndrome logical error at the same look
precision.cap_rule: if precision is not met by 8192 matched shots or the wall cap, retain inconclusive estimates and intervals; never extend silently
precision.cross_arm_claim: no statistical difference or ranking test is prespecified

claim_limit: No source-faithful curve reproduction, publication-level assessment, quaternary/circuit claim, or universal decoder ranking.
